Lock release in update_registry_path(): 'import fcntl' at L92 sits inside 'if lock_fd is not None:' (L91) in the finally block. lock_fd is initialised None at L57 and only assigned under 'if sys.platform != "win32"' (L58), so L92 is unreachable on Windows. FPLAN-0382 wave 1: line refreshed 89 -> 92 and reason corrected (the old text described the L59 sys.platform guard, not the L91 lock_fd guard) — verified by lifting the rule and re-running the checker, which named L92 exactly.
